title: At the weekend
subtitle: しゅうまつ
review: Written by Claude. The Japanese, the romaji and the recordings have not been checked by a Japanese speaker. English support only: no Burmese lines were written.
intro: Two friends talk about what they do at the weekend. Listen for what each of them likes.
steps: Press Play all with the text hidden. Who is speaking, and where are they?
Listen again, then answer the questions under the dialogue.
Tap the lines to show the text, and listen once more while reading.
Shadow it: play a line, press Pause (or the space bar), say it aloud, then Resume.
Take a role and say your lines in the pauses.

lines.romaji: Shūmatsu wa nani o shimasu ka.
lines.kana: しゅうまつはなにをしますか。

tr.en: What do you do at the weekend?

lines.kana: ともだちとサッカーをします。

tr.en: I play football with my friends.

lines.say: 友達とサッカーをします。

lines.romaji: Ii desu ne. Sakkā ga suki desu ka.
lines.kana: いいですね。サッカーがすきですか。

tr.en: That's nice. Do you like football?

lines.say: いいですね。サッカーが好きですか。

lines.kana: はい、だいすきです。ミカさんは？

tr.en: Yes, I love it. And you, Mika?

lines.say: はい、大好きです。ミカさんは？

lines.romaji: Watashi wa uchi de eiga o mimasu.
lines.kana: わたしはうちでえいがをみます。
lines.say: 私はうちで映画を見ます。

lines.romaji: Donna eiga ga suki desu ka.
lines.kana: どんなえいががすきですか。

tr.en: What kind of films do you like?

lines.say: どんな映画が好きですか。

lines.romaji: Boku mo desu. Kondo issho ni mimashō.
lines.kana: ぼくもです。こんどいっしょにみましょう。

tr.en: Me too. Let's watch one together sometime.

lines.say: 僕もです。今度一緒に見ましょう。

questions.q: What does Daiki do at the weekend?
questions.why: Tomodachi to sakkā o shimasu = I play football with friends.
Uchi de eiga o mimasu = I watch films at home.

questions.q: What kind of films does Mika like?
questions.why: Anime ga suki desu = I like anime.

notes: [Thing] ga suki desu = I like [thing]. daisuki = like very much.
boku = I (used by men, casual). watashi = I.
